question: Should OpenClaw add a public `agents.setDefault` Gateway/protocol/SDK/Admin HTTP RPC, or should clients continue to use the existing config mutation path for this operation?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but this is a new public operator API and the linked implementation was closed unmerged specifically because maintainer sponsorship is required.

options.title: Require sponsorship first
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer API decision and avoid new automated fix PRs until the public RPC direction is explicitly accepted.

options.title: Sponsor `agents.setDefault`
options.body: Reopen or recreate the prior focused implementation and land the additive RPC with compatibility, permission-scope, generated protocol, SDK, Admin HTTP RPC, docs, and regression proof.

options.title: Decline the new RPC
options.body: Close this issue and document that external clients should use `config.patch` or `config.set` for default-agent changes.

recommendation.title: Require sponsorship first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer API decision and avoid new automated fix PRs until the public RPC direction is explicitly accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the sibling Gateway agent CRUD API family that this request extends, making them the strongest history-backed owner for the API-shape decision.
